locations.title: Admission to the New Camp
locations.description:
**POINT OF NO RETURN**

**Chapter 1 - ENDING**

**How to Start:** Talk with [Mordrag](#loc=595509) and ask him for the escort to the New Camp 

**Quest Steps:**
- **REQUIRED** Bring [Lares](#loc=596078) Supply List from the Old Mine during [Test of Faith](#loc=603835) Quest and complete [Something the Matter?](#loc=605734) Quest
- Complete [Thirsty Farmers](#loc=595804) Quest
- Complete [Up to His Neck](#loc=596142) Quest
- Complete [The Dam Lurker](#loc=595814) Quest
- Complete [A Piece of the Pie](#loc=605733) Quest
- Complete [The Herb Merchant](#loc=598439) Quest
- Complete [The Raid](#loc=605763) Quest


**Reward:**
- 1,000 XP
- [Bandit's Dress ](#loc=605765)

**Next Quest:** [The Brotherhood's Plan](#loc=607201)

**Note:** [Admission to the Swamp Camp](#loc=595738) and [Admission to the Old Camp](#loc=595210) Quests will be failed once Lares allows the Hero to join the New Camp

locations.title: Thirsty Farmers
locations.description:
**Chapter 1**

**How to Start:** Approach [Lefty](#loc=595803) while he's guarding peasants in the rice fields

**Quest Steps:**
- Get water from [Ulmar](#loc=595789)
- Hand out water to 10 rice farmers 
- Report back to [Lefty](#loc=595803)
- To complete this quest, beat up Lefty and tell him that it's his job to hand out water
- ??

**Reward:**
- 100 XP(every cycle)
- 300 XP

**Next Quest:** ??

locations.title: A Few Drops Too Much
locations.description:
**Chapter 1**

**How to Start:** Talk to [Rice Lord](#loc=595806) and ask if he needs any help

**Quest Steps:**
- Talk to [Silas](#loc=596137) in [New Camp's Tavern](#loc=596132)
- Deal with [Rayk](#loc=596136)
- Report to [Silas](#loc=596137)
- Report back to [Rice Lord](#loc=595806)

**Reward:**
- 400 XP
- Ore Nugget x25(if confronted about his problems with Rayk)

**Next Quest:** [Up to His Neck](#loc=596142)

locations.title: Up to His Neck
locations.description:
**Chapter 1**

**Quest Steps:**
- Ask [Malon](#loc=595809) about Bran
- Beat up [Renyu](#loc=605346) to ge access to the [Bandit's Cave](#loc=605343)
- Beat up [Jacko](#loc=605353) to learn more about Bran
- Talk to [Silas](#loc=596137) about Bran
- Get to the tavern basement by looking for an [entrance underwater](#loc=605362)
- Locate [Bran's Corpse](#loc=605363) and his [Axe](#loc=605367)
- Report back to [Rice Lord](#loc=595806) 

**Reward:**
- 150 XP
- 300 XP

**Previous Quest:** [A Few Drops Too Much](#loc=595807)

locations.description:
**Chapter 1**

**How to Start:** Talk to [Baal Kagan](#loc=596064) to help him peddle his swampweed

- Enter the Sleeper Temple with Ur-Nazkrog

**Reward:**
- 300 XP - after defeating Grazkrak 
- 1,000 XP

**Next Quests:**
- [A Warrior's Honor](#loc=926886)
- [The Dreamer's Nightmare](#loc=926899)

locations.title: A Warrior's Honor
locations.description:
**Chapter 5**

**How to Start:** Talk to [Ur-Nazkrog](#loc=926885)

**Quest Steps:**
- Talk to Ur-Shak by the entrance to the Sleeper Temple
- Collect 3 Orc Spores on orc corpses in the Fighting Ground to get through [Umosh](#loc=926879)
- Perform burial traditions on Grazkrak's body
- Report back to [Ur-Nazkrog](#loc=926885)

**Reward:**
- 700 XP

locations.title: Acquired Taste
locations.description:
**Chapter 5**

**How to Start:** Talk to [Muk](#loc=926892) while [Umakhal](#loc=926880) is not around

**Quest Steps:**
- Bring Muk a Meatbug Ragout

**Reward:**
- 300 XP


**Note:** Using a tunnel in Muk's cave will cause everyone in the Enclave to be hostile if seen by the Temple Warriors

locations.title: The Dreamer's Nightmare
locations.description:
**Chapter 5**

**How to Start:** Enter The Sleeper Temple for the first time either by completing [A Warrior's Honor](#loc=926886) Quest or using [Muk's Hidden Tunnel](#loc=926893)

**Quest Steps:**
- Defeat 3 Orc Shamans:
   - [Varrag Hashor](#loc=926900)
   - [Varrag Kasorg](#loc=926901)
   - [Varrag Unhilqt](#loc=926902)
- Defeat [Fire Demon](#loc=926934)
- Defeat 2 Orc Shamans:
   - [Varrag Arushat](#loc=926904)
   - [Varrag Ruuushk](#loc=926903)
- Pick up [Strange Sword / Uriziel](#loc=926960)
- Show the sword to [Xardas](#loc=595733)

**Reward:**
- 8,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Hashor
- 8,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Kasorg
- 8,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Unhilqt
- 500 XP - after defeating Fire Demon
- 1,500 XP - for 3 Demon Lords
- 10,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Arushat
- 8,000 XP - after defeating Varrag Ruuushk
- 1,000 XP - after talking to Xardas
- 2,000 XP

**Next Quest:** [Uriziel](#loc=926961)

locations.title: Uriziel
locations.description:
**Chapter 5**

**How to Start:** Show [Uriziel](#loc=926960) to Xardas at the end of the [The Dreamer's Nightmare](#loc=926899) Quest

**Quest Steps:**
- Talk to Milten in the Saturas' chamber
- Talk to Gorn about the guards
- Return to Milten
- Bribe or kill a guard to get to the Ore Pile
- Charge the Uriziel
- Return to Xardas

**Gemstones:**
- [Worldcleaver](#loc=926919)
- [Lightbringer](#loc=926923)
- [Timesplinter](#loc=926926)
- [Fiendeye](#loc=926959)
- [Banstone](#loc=926947)

**Reward:**
- 5,000 XP
- [Charged Uriziel](#loc=926960)

**Next Quest:** [The Sleeper's Awakening](#loc=926963)

locations.title: The Sleeper's Awakening
locations.description:
**Chapter 6**

**How to Start:** Complete [Uriziel](#loc=926961) Quest

**Quest Steps:**
- Reach the last chamber at the end of the [Sleeper Temple](#loc=595714)
- Defeat [Mad Minecrawler Queen](#loc=926970)
- Defeat [Mad Mud](#loc=926971)
- Defeat [Mad Diego](#loc=926972)
- Defeat [Mad Gorn](#loc=926973)
- Defeat [Mad Milten](#loc=926974)
- Defeat [Mad Lester](#loc=926975)
- Defeat [Mad Xardas](#loc=926976)
- Defeat [Mad Demon](#loc=926977)
- Defeat [The Sleeper](#loc=892231)

**Reward:**
- Game is Completed
